user.title: Set up Steuertage
user.description: Set up everything in this dialog. The work location is where you travel for work. The threshold is the minimum time spent in the work zone or, when enabled, the home zone before a day is counted automatically (default: 2 hours). Homeoffice and work calendar are optional; their extra selectors are also optional unless the corresponding feature is enabled.

data.threshold_hours: Minimum time before a day counts (hours; default 2)
data.home_zone: Home zone (optional; required when Homeoffice detection is enabled)
data.homeoffice_device: Homeoffice device (optional; required when Homeoffice detection is enabled)

features.title: Optional features
features.description: Choose a feature to set it up, or return to edit the required details. Afterwards, you can configure another feature or finish setup.

homeoffice.title: Homeoffice detection
homeoffice.description: Choose the home zone and device used to detect Homeoffice.

work_calendar.title: Work calendar
work_calendar.description: Choose a calendar integrated with Home Assistant. Timed and all-day entries are supported.

basics.title: Required setup details
basics.description: Update the person, work location or threshold, then continue with the optional features.
